messages:
Ashley: Heads-up — noticed a spike in "unassigned" inbound leads this morning. looks correlated with enrichment timeouts from HubSpot (fields not returning). :(
Mike: ugh. saw a few alerts. which workflows are failing?
Ashley: appears to be the enrichment webhook that triggers the RR assignment. HubSpot sometimes returns partial payloads => our claim service skips and leaves leads unowned.
Priya: can we add a short TTL + heartbeat so we don’t leave leads floating? e.g., if enrichment > 10s, run a fallback assignment.
Sam: yes pls. customer sales queues are getting clogged. Sales said they saw ~40 leads w/o owner in SF.
Mike: quick diag — looks like two issues: 1) enrichment service retries are exponential but capped too low, 2) our round-robin service treats null owner as retry indefinitely.
Ashley: proposal: add observability probe + metric, and a 10s enrichment grace window. If enrichment not back by then, run a lightweight RR assignment using available fields (email or phone).
Priya: agree. also add a label so we can trace which leads were fallback-assigned vs normal. e.g., `fallback_owner:true`.
Mike: minimal probe I sketched:```json
{
  "probe": "enrichment_latency",
  "window_sec": 60,
  "threshold_ms": 10000,
  "action": "emit_metric|trigger_fallback"
}
```
Sam: can we also surface this in a Slack alert channel? sales-ops wants real-time visibility.
Ashley: yes — send aggregated counts and an example lead id + payload (PII redacted). put a short digest every 5m and an incident if > 50 unassigned in 10m.
Priya: FYI HubSpotBot just reported a partial webhook response around `2026-03-22T09:12:04Z` for integration `hs-enrich-v2`. might be related.
HubSpotBot: [system] webhook failure: hs-enrich-v2, status 502, response_time 12145ms, body_snippet "{customer:{} }"
Mike: perfect, that ties the timing. I'll wire the probe + fallback in the RR service today and add a metric `lead.fallback_assign_count`.
Ashley: can you add a canary flag so we only run fallback for 10% of traffic first? want to make sure quality doesn't drop.
Mike: yep — `fallback_canary_pct=10` default. will roll via feature flag.
Priya: test matrix: (1) enrichment ok => normal RR, (2) enrichment delayed => fallback owner, flagged, (3) enrichment recovers after fallback => reconcile owner if enrichment provides stronger match.
Sam: make sure SF owner mapping gets updated when enrichment later returns, otherwise reps will see duplicates.
Ashley: action items: Mike will implement probe + fallback canary, Priya will update playbook and notify sales-ops, Sam will prepare SF mapping checks, I'll coordinate a 1-hour canary window and watch metrics. :eyes:
Priya: tagging for docs — add a small note to the inbound playbook about TTLs and fallback.
Mike: ping me if you want the probe config to be more aggressive. rolling this in staging at 16:00 PST.
Ashley: thanks all. if staging looks good we'll enable canary at 10% for 1h and escalate if anything odd. :thumbsup:
